profile.description: Yanbu Cement Company, together with its subsidiaries, engages in manufacturing, producing, and trading of cement and related products in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and internationally. It offers ordinary and premium Portland, Pozzolanic Portland, green cement, finishing Portland, and sulphate resistance cement products. The company is also involved in the manufacturing and wholesale trading of cement paper; and sale of packed, bulk cement, clinker, and cement bags. Yanbu Cement Company was founded in 1977 and is headquartered in Jeddah, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.
